newLayers.name: Resource Profiles and Scheduling
newLayers.description: How tasks and executors declare the resources they need: ResourceProfile with ExecutorResourceRequests and TaskResourceRequests, the builder, the ResourceProfileManager that tracks profiles in use, resource discovery (ResourceUtils and the discovery script plugin), ResourceInformation and the ResourceAllocator that hands out resource addresses.

appendDesc.Java and Python API Bridges: Also covers the Python worker utilities (PythonWorkerUtils, SerDeUtil, StreamingPythonRunner, worker log capture) and the R API bridge: RBackend and its handlers, RRunner, RRDD and the R serialization code.

tour.title: Resource profiles: what tasks and executors ask for
tour.description: A ResourceProfile describes the executor resources (cores, memory, GPUs and other custom resources) and the task resources a stage needs. It is built with ResourceProfileBuilder from ExecutorResourceRequests and TaskResourceRequests, registered with the ResourceProfileManager, and its resources are discovered on a node by ResourceUtils (optionally through a discovery script) and handed to tasks by ResourceAllocator as ResourceInformation.
